load_torch_tensor_file: load tensors from a PyTorch tensor file using TensorFileLoader with optional mmap and restrict options
dump_torch_tensor_file: dump tensors to a PyTorch tensor file using TensorFileDumper with configurable pickle protocol
load_safetensors_file: load Hugging Face Safetensors files using SafetensorsLoader with device placement and mmap support
handle_corrupt_file_error: handle CorruptFileError exceptions when loading erroneous tensor or Safetensors files
configure_tensor_load_options: configure TensorFileLoadOptions with map_location, mmap, and restrict settings for tensor file loading
